name: project-init
description: Scaffold how a project is run under Orca and oh-my-claudecode (the operating model, the worker roster, the workstream register, the worker brief) and report to the owner on a live status board.

board_link_row.title: Board link above the prompt
board_link_row.description: Show a button above the prompt, in a session of a project that has a board, that opens the board in your browser. The button is drawn whenever either board link switch is on; only both off hides it. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later. On unless you turn it off.

board_link_status_line.title: Board link in the status line
board_link_status_line.description: Also put the board's link in your status line: an addition beside the button above the prompt, which it never replaces. Off until you set it up with /project-init:board-link, which edits nothing without your yes.
